packageRules.description: The go directive is OWNED by devbox-update (ci-workflows v2.10.0): it aligns go.mod to the toolchain triple in the same PR as devbox.lock. Renovate leaves `go` alone so the three can never disagree.

creachadair/mds is pinned to upstream go-cache-plugin's version inside third_party/go-cache-plugin, and moving it breaks the build -- that mismatch is the reason the directory is a separate module at all (see its go.mod). Left to Renovate this becomes a grouped, automerging PR that can never go green, and because the group carries every other non-major bump, one un-bumpable dependency would block them all. The way this dependency moves is a go-cache-plugin bump plus a re-vendor, not a bump of its own.
